pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ Y ngược đối xứng, chân kim cương, dây văng đỏ (phối cảnh PM02); nhịp chính 350 m là ước tính
pylons_en: 2 symmetric inverted-Y pylons with diamond feet, red stays (PM02 render); 350 m main span is an estimate

pylon_custom.description: Inverted Y per the PM02 render: legs pass just outside the 33.5 m deck, converge below it to a narrower footing (diamond foot), merge ≈55% of the above-deck height into a slim head; two planes of red stays fan from the head.

model3d.notes: From the PM02 competition render (Pháp Luật / Thanh Niên, 4/2026). Main span 350 m is a client-chosen estimate; the render's pylon-to-span proportion suggests a somewhat longer span, so pylon height (≈110 m above deck, ≈165 m total incl. ≈55 m clearance) is estimated. Side spans with one auxiliary pier each to total ≈870 m.

checklist.head: pass (slim head)
checklist.proportions: limited (350 m span is an estimate; render implies taller pylons relative to the span)
checklist.deck / aux piers: pass (one auxiliary pier per side span, estimated)
